item.title: Kansas’ Chiefs deal criticized by both parties over ‘tax giveaways for billionaires’
item.description: In a crowded hearing in Topeka last week, Kansas lawmakers drilled a lawyer for the Kansas City Chiefs on the deal to bring the NFL team across the state line.

item.title: Kansas land values reflect stability
item.description: MANHATTAN, Kan. — Kansas agricultural land values appear to be stabilizing as producers enter 2026, according to Kansas State University Extension experts.

item.title: A for-profit immigrant detention center in Leavenworth, Kansas, is one step closer to opening
item.description: Leavenworth, Kansas — A private prison company has moved one step closer to opening a planned 1,000-bed immigration detention center in Kansas, but with restrictions included by local government officials after hearing a raft of concerns from the public.

item.title: Newton Public Library Launches book Clubs for February
item.description: The Newton Public Library is preparing to launch a series of new book clubs in February, offering readers a wide range of genres—from classic young-adult mysteries and gripping nonfiction to historical fiction and contemporary romance. Each club will feature a guided discussion led by library staff.

item.title: Kansas Profile: Wade Newland, ag drones
item.description: Modern technology makes it possible for farmers to do remarkable things with their ground. Now, modern technology is making it possible for farmers to do remarkable things through the air.

item.title: Harvey County doubles driver’s license fee
item.description: County Treasurer Amy Perkins approached the Harvey County Commission in December with a proposal to increase the fees charged in the county-operated Driver’s License office as a way to reduce the department’s ongoing deficit.
